audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 with a 7/10 carry threat fits 54.55% over 297 games: Quinn owns levels 1-3, K'Sante reclaims from 6 onward. The recorded 'chart contradicts data' defect is not a ratings problem — Quinn's win rate comes from converting the early window into map pressure, which the text already says.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 read K'Sante while its why says 'comes down to who lands first', and Level 6 read Quinn while its why says his R 'dashes you into a wall and isolates you — your squishy frame gets deleted'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Quinn, Skill, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante. Both mismatched rows are captioned by text that already states the correct side.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill and row 4 to K'Sante, in matched full/content pairs. Rows 0, 1, 3, 5 and 6 already agree. Spike ladder (lvl 1 range, lvl 2-3 punish, lvl 6 R isolation, 2+ items tank-fighter) is accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The knockup is attributed to Ntofo Strikes in five places ('his Q knockup', 'Q-knockup all-in'). Ntofo Strikes pulls enemies IN at two stacks; the knockback and stun are Path Maker (W). Path Maker's true damage and All Out's healing are never mentioned either.
audit.why: Kit: Q 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in', 3.5s cooldown, 450 range. W 'dashes, knocking back and stunning', 14s, flagged trueDamage. R All Out grants healing, 120s at rank 1. Missing-interaction rows list needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated for this matchup.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] now use the real mechanics; breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d carry the 3.5s / 14s / 120s numbers, the true-damage warning against stacking armour, and the anti-heal requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Plated Steelcaps as the boot without noting Path Maker deals true damage.
audit.why: True damage ignores armour, so armour boots are not the mitigation the line implies against his engage.
audit.corrected: Stated in the cooldown block and report[5].t rather than rewriting the item string, which is otherwise sound (Steelcaps still answer his autos).

edits.before: You out-range his melee Q knockup and Harrier-reset autos for free poke before he has W block.
edits.after: You out-range Ntofo Strikes at 450 and get free Harrier-reset poke before Path Maker is leveled.

edits.before: Q blind into E-Vault repositions out of his Q-knockup all-in — your cleanest punish window before items.
edits.after: Blinding Assault into Vault repositions out of the Ntofo Strikes pull — your cleanest punish before items.

edits.before: Use E-Vault to escape his Q knockup and W dash whenever he steps to all-in
edits.after: Vault out of the Ntofo Strikes pull and the Path Maker stun when he steps up

edits.before: Land his Q knockup or W dash to pin you in range of his all-in
edits.after: Land the Ntofo Strikes pull or the Path Maker stun to pin you down

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: 120s at rank 1 — his duelist mode, so poke while it is down. - Path Maker: 14s, and its true damage means armour is not the answer. - Ntofo Strikes: 3.5s, pulls you in at two stacks.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His duelist mode, 120s at rank 1 — poke while it is down, and bring anti-heal.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. Poke when it’s down. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: All Out is 120s and heals him — anti-heal early. Path Maker's true damage ignores the armour you buy.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him and hits harder — disengage until it ends.
